rule: Add two supplied packed-BCD point bytes to the selected player's three packed-BCD score bytes, decimal-adjusting each byte and discarding overflow beyond six decimal digits.
limits: These are supplied-operand BCD arithmetic checks on 25 executing source calls; they do not establish why points were awarded, which items score, scoring cadence, 2-player source parity, displayed numeral rendering or victory bonuses. Invalid BCD inputs fail explicitly. No source instruction bytes, recorded point values or private RAM arrays are published.
